ranked.headline: Learned models infer spatial niches and regulatory networks from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics method papers now span niche discovery, gene set enrichment, panel design, and multi-omics network inference.

ranked.headline: Integrative models link methylation, accessibility and loops to regulatory activity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply multimodal and sequence-based models to quantify chromatin regulation at bulk and single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Methods assign cell identity to bulk, single-cell, spatial and optical measurements
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add validation of individual analysis steps and interactive annotation to inferring cell composition and identity from diverse omics data.

ranked.headline: Open software frameworks standardize, test, and prioritize omics features
ranked.summary: Recent releases package reproducibility-focused statistics, QTL containers, and lipidomic QC as accessible open-source software.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and nucleic-acid models are stress-tested against baselines in…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify where protein and DNA foundation models fail, using explicit baselines and task-specific stress tests.

ranked.headline: Relational models link single-cell dynamics, spatial gaps and counterfactual states
ranked.summary: Recent work extends graph, gene-network, and transport models from spatial imputation to counterfactual and population-level single-cell inference.

ranked.headline: Transcriptome-wide RNA sequence profiling links sequence features to regulatory function
ranked.summary: Nucleic acid foundation models outperform classical tools for lncRNA coding potential, alongside improved RNA-DNA and modification profiling.

ranked.headline: Protein embeddings and domain architectures reshape orthology inference across genomes
ranked.summary: Newer orthology and pangenome methods report accuracy gains alongside lower runtime and memory as genomic datasets scale.

ranked.headline: Simulation and design map disordered regions, peptide binders and ligand pockets
ranked.summary: Structure prediction, enhanced sampling and free energy methods now target disordered regions and de novo designed peptides, not only static poses.

ranked.headline: Sequence-level assays reveal unintended eGFP products and editing outcomes
ranked.summary: Pipeline-scale sequencing of constructs and edited genomes now quantifies outcomes beyond intended design.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and diffusion models extract more reliable structure from cryo-EM density
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow push cryo-EM interpretation toward ligand detection near 5 Å and voxel-level uncertainty in map enhancement.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models infer hidden processes and phylogenies from lineage trees
ranked.summary: Lineage recordings and tree-based likelihood methods make hidden historical processes in cell and species trees inferable.

ranked.headline: Predictive models close the loop on selective drug combinations and signaling regulators
ranked.summary: Iterative experimental loops increasingly condition candidate selection on explicit predictive models for combination and pathway studies.

ranked.headline: Regulatory sequence models increasingly encode biological context for interpretability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair DNA and expression models with explicit regulatory priors, motif attribution, and mechanistic constraints.

ranked.headline: Cell-type resolution links regulatory variants and enhancers to complex disease genes
ranked.summary: Cell-type-resolved eQTL, enhancer, and annotation-stratified analyses now test regulatory and trait-level genetic effects against GWAS anchors.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and multimodal encoders for molecular and drug property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published DDI study test pretrained, multimodal and reasoning-augmented encoders on ADME, transporter and resistance tasks.

ranked.headline: Hierarchical immune cell identity assignment from scRNA-seq and DNA methylation data
ranked.summary: Population-scale scRNA-seq collections and independent expert-annotated benchmarks make hierarchical, reference-based cell identity assignment testable at…

ranked.headline: Foundation models couple histology images with spatial transcriptomic expression profiles
ranked.summary: Multimodal models now link histology, spatial transcriptomics and language, while benchmarks question how genomic and single-cell foundation models compare.

ranked.headline: Tumor genomic selection and passenger mutations assessed at functional resolution
ranked.summary: Domain-level selection scans, single-nucleus regulatory atlases and xenograft multi-omics now resolve functional consequence beyond gene-level association.

ranked.headline: Simulations and docking resolve protein gating and interaction energetics
ranked.summary: Recent work couples MD, docking and cryo-EM to variant-resolved interaction energetics across transporters, Complex I and viral assembly.

ranked.headline: LLM agents are being built and benchmarked for biological pathway and model analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether LLM agents can reliably interpret transcriptomic, metabolic, and literature-derived evidence for biological hypotheses.

ranked.headline: Efficient protein language and structure models target antibodies and binding interfaces
ranked.summary: Preprints this period pair faster structure and language-model pipelines with antibody, interface and trajectory prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Predictive models in drug and genomics paired with checks on performance transfer
ranked.summary: Recent items pair predictive models with explicit tests of whether performance holds on new datasets, cohorts, or changed conditions.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models design binders, rank pockets, and score protein-ligand affinity
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair generative and scoring models with pocket exploration to target conformations, shallow pockets, and multimeric interfaces.

ranked.headline: Integrated pipelines and k-mer methods streamline microbial genome sequencing analysis
ranked.summary: Automated multi-stage pipelines now span long-read assembly, typing, and population analysis, while targeted classifiers cut memory and runtime.

ranked.headline: Pretrained DNA and protein models are repurposed to infer evolutionary relationships
ranked.summary: Foundation-model embeddings built for regulatory and protein tasks are now being tested directly on phylogenetic and taxonomic inference.

ranked.headline: Internal geometry and stability test proposed mechanisms of cortical learning
ranked.summary: Current work judges proposed neural mechanisms by the geometry, stability, and readout robustness of their internal dynamics.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models tightened with enzyme, expression, and growth constraints
ranked.summary: Early-June 2026 preprints pair enzyme, expression, and flux or growth data with genome-scale models to resolve in vivo metabolic constraints.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale genomes link duplication and TE activity to lineage-level adaptation
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies across plants, mammals and ants now resolve how duplication and transposable element activity reshape eukaryotic genomes.

ranked.headline: New tools for RAD-seq sex markers, multiomic profiling and sequencing benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair memory-bounded, single-binary and benchmarking tools with faster multiomic and biobank-scale sequencing analysis.

ranked.headline: Tools automate segmentation and quantification of diverse microscopy image modalities
ranked.summary: Recent releases package deep-learning and semi-automatic segmentation of microscopy data into accessible, integrated app and web workflows.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level genomes and sedaDNA detection limits for non-model taxa
ranked.summary: Assembled chromosome-level references now extend to non-model arthropods and crustaceans, alongside detection-limit benchmarking for sedaDNA.

ranked.headline: Refined null calibration sharpens omics enrichment and microbial network inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods revise enrichment and network statistics with weighted integral scores, Bayesian models, and permutation-based FDR control.

ranked.headline: Deep topographic models recover cortical organization from neural recordings
ranked.summary: Topographic foundation-model and transformer approaches now yield spatially structured, individualized representations of brain activity and connectivity.

ranked.headline: Reference pools expand oxidized phospholipid annotation in untargeted LC-MS/MS
ranked.summary: RISOP reports more than doubled oxidized phospholipid annotations; other items add proteomics analysis and NGS metadata tools.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold2 structural models and curated labels now cover missense variants at scale
ranked.summary: Public resources now pair predicted variant structures with expert-curated labels and drug-binding maps to benchmark and interpret missense effects.

ranked.headline: Functional diversification and gene duplication shape protein and giant virus evolution
ranked.summary: Two decades of metagenomic time series and analyses of over 1,000 proteomes now resolve evolutionary dynamics at the functional and domain level.

ranked.headline: Edge- and cycle-level connectivity measures linking network structure to dynamics
ranked.summary: Four preprints apply edge-, cycle-, and perturbation-based formalisms to infer interaction structure from fMRI, single-cell, and gene regulatory data.

ranked.headline: Linking transcript-derived isoform models to peptide and intact proteoform MS readouts
ranked.summary: Recent isoform, proteoform, and intact-protein studies couple transcript-level models to proteomic measurements at multiple scales.

ranked.headline: Unified learning models predict PTM sites, metabolic fluxes and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Multi-modal and knowledge-graph-based models now predict PTM sites, flux intervals and knockout responses, with a focus on interpretable architectures.
